name: Eric Zimmerman

bio.statement: The City of Portland says Zimmerman was elected District 4 city councilor in November 2024 and began his term in January 2025.
bio.excerpt: Elected as City Councilor for District 4 in November 2024 and began their term of office in January 2025.

bio.statement: Zimmerman's city candidate filing form lists past roles as Multnomah County chief of staff, City of Portland senior advisor and Medford deputy city manager.
bio.excerpt: Chief of Staff, Multnomah County; Senior Advisor, City of Portland; Deputy City Manager, City of Medford;

source.publisher: City of Portland Auditor's Office, Elections

bio.statement: Zimmerman's filing form lists service in the Oregon Army National Guard and U.S. Army.

source.publisher: City of Portland Auditor's Office, Elections

positions.statement: On his City of Portland council page, Zimmerman says he is committed to promoting livability, public safety and growth.
positions.excerpt: I am committed to promoting livability, public safety, and growth throughout Portland.

verification.note: Stated priorities on an incumbent's official office page are T2 (policy section 1), consistent with earlier batches; tier changed from T1.

positions.statement: OPB reports that if re-elected Zimmerman promises to prioritize funding public safety, cutting taxes and fixing potholes.
positions.excerpt: If elected a second term, Zimmerman promises to prioritize funding public safety, cutting taxes and fixing potholes.

positions.statement: OPB reports that as a councilor Zimmerman has pushed for a more expedited permitting system for new construction.
positions.excerpt: As a councilor, he’s pushed for a more expedited permitting system for new construction

positions.statement: Zimmerman's campaign website, as quoted in a Portland Mercury candidate profile, says ending unsanctioned camping as quickly as possible is a must.
positions.excerpt: (e)nding unsanctioned camping as quickly as possible is a must for Portland.

verification.note: The Mercury quotes this from Zimmerman's campaign website, not an interview; attribution corrected.

positions.statement: Zimmerman's campaign website, as quoted in a Portland Mercury candidate profile, says the city needs to implement a 'Shelter Now' policy.
positions.excerpt: we need to implement a ‘Shelter Now’ policy.

verification.note: The Mercury quotes this from Zimmerman's campaign website; attribution corrected.

gaps: Voters' pamphlet statement not readable: the individual statement PDF in the county's Military & Overseas Online Voters' Guide is a scan with no machine-readable text, and the full and large-print county pamphlet PDFs are cut off by the fetch tool (~105k characters) before the City of Portland section (pp. M-52 to M-66)

verification_summary.balance_notes: D4: 8 items (3 T1, 1 T2 after tier fix, 4 T3). Pamphlet statement is a scan with no machine-readable text and the full pamphlet is truncated before the city section (confirmed source gap). Website ez4pdx.com printed on AUD-120; not used as T2 source although the Mercury quotes it. Incumbent true confirmed (He/Him). p4/p5 attribution corrected to campaign website as quoted by the Mercury.
